head: Gemini 4 Carbon now available more widely, in the Gemini app with AI Ultra
dek: Google opened Gemini 4 Carbon, its model for complex coding and research, beyond the cybersecurity teams that got it first in October. In the Gemini app it's for Google AI Ultra subscribers, who pay $100 a month.
details: Developers can use it on the paid tier of Google AI Studio and Android Studio, and businesses through Gemini for business. Ultra subscribers also get it in AI Mode in Search and the Antigravity coding platform. Google says Gemini 4 Argon is still the better pick for most everyday tasks. It's also giving 10,000 scientists free access for six months.
where: Gemini app (AI Ultra), Google AI Studio, Gemini for business
means: Most people won't see Carbon unless they pay for AI Ultra; the everyday Gemini models stay the same.
todo: Nothing to do on cheaper plans; if you have AI Ultra, pick Carbon for long coding or research tasks.
